context7.description: Up-to-date documentation and code examples for the libraries and frameworks you use, fetched when the agent needs them.

playwright.description: Drives a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots and test a web app, from the page structure rather than pictures.

chromedevtools.description: Lets the agent debug and measure a web page in Chrome: network, console, performance traces and what the page really does.

sequentialthinking.description: A tool to think a hard problem through in steps, revise earlier steps and try another path before answering.

dbhub.description: Reads the schema and runs queries on your database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server or SQLite, through one connection string.

figma.description: Gives the agent the layout and styles of a Figma file or frame, so that it can build the interface from the design.

firecrawl.description: Scrapes and crawls websites into clean text, including pages that need JavaScript, and extracts structured data from them.

huggingface.description: Searches models, datasets, Spaces and papers on the Hugging Face Hub, and reads their documentation.
